extracted.name: Groovy Green Smoothie
extracted.description: This groovy green smoothie recipe is a refreshing blend of fresh spinach, green grapes, apple, and yogurt for a bright and energizing breakfast smoothie.
instruction_lines: Place spinach, banana, grapes, yogurt, and apple into a blender. Cover, and blend until smooth, stopping frequently to push down anything stuck to the sides. Pour into two glasses and serve.
